object.description: Run Export on a document with suspect outgoing links and answer the export warning with Cancel; run Export on a document with no link problems; run Export and choose an output path. Expected: after Cancel no save dialog opens; with no link problems the save dialog opens with no warning before it; the PDF is written to the path chosen in the save dialog.
